Level 17 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 1
Order: Recruit

Your Bastion becomes linked to an unfathomable demiplane of vast, empty spaces and strange beings. The facility takes up no space: its entrance appears in the closets, crawlspaces, and shadows of your Bastion's other facilities. Its hireling protects the inhabitants from stray entities slipping out of the demiplane. This facility always counts as Haunted.

Dark Bargains. You can wander within for 7 days, consulting and bargaining with the entities there; if you leave the Bastion during that time, you gain nothing. At the end of the seventh day, you gain a Dark Gift feat of your choice. You can have only one feat from this benefit at a time: a new one replaces the previous one.

Recruit: Stranger. The hireling performs a 7-day ritual costing 1,000 GP to petition an entity of the demiplane. Then roll any die. On an odd number, the entity refuses and kills the hireling, and the facility can't be used until your next Bastion turn, when the hireling is replaced at no cost. On an even number, the entity agrees and takes up residence in your Liminal Space.

A resident entity counts as a Bastion Defender, and if your Bastion is attacked, each one reduces by 1 the number of dice you roll to see how many defenders are lost. You can choose not to count it as a defender; it then acts according to its nature, using the Unspeakable Horror stat block. You can have up to three entities at a time; remove those you lose from your roster.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
